API ReferenceZscaler Digital Experience APIReportsGets the list of all users and their devices that were used to access an application
Gets the list of all users and their devices that were used to access an application
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/zdx/v1/apps/:appid/users

Gets the list of all users and their devices that were used to access an application. The endpoint allows to get the list of users based on the score category (i.e., Poor, Okay, or Good), location, department, or geoloaction. If the time range is not specified, the endpoint defaults to the last 2 hours.

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
appid
integer
REQUIRED

The application ID assigned by ZDX. For example, 12 for Microsoft Teams Call Quality.

Example: 12
QUERY PARAMETERS
from
integer

Possible values: >= 0

The start time (in seconds) for the query. The value is entered in Unix Epoch. If not entered, returns the data for the last 2 hours.

to
integer

Possible values: >= 0

The end time (in seconds) for the query. The value is entered in Unix Epoch. If not entered, returns the data for the last 2 hours.

score_bucket
string

Possible values: [poor, okay, good]

The ZDX score category (i.e., Poor, Okay, or Good).

loc
integer[]

The Zscaler location (ID). You can add multiple location IDs.

exclude_loc
integer[]

The Zscaler location (ID). You can add multiple location IDs.

dept
integer[]

The department (ID). You can add multiple department IDs.

exclude_dept
integer[]

The department (ID). You can add multiple department IDs.

geo
string[]

The active geolocation (ID). You can add multiple active geolocation IDs.

exclude_geo
string[]

The active geolocation (ID). You can add multiple active geolocation IDs.

offset
string

The next_offset value from the last request. You must enter this value to get the next batch from the list. When the next_offset value becomes null, the list is complete.

limit
integer

Possible values: >= 1 and <= 10000

The number of items that must be returned per request from the list.

Default value: 1000
Responses
​
200
401
403

Successful Operation

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
SCHEMA
users
object[]
next_offset
string

This value must be entered in the next request to get the next batch from the list.
